headline: Mayoral appointments to Public Works Commission and Parks and Recreation Commission to be reviewed.
summary: The committee will consider five mayoral appointments to city boards, including one to the Public Works Commission and four to the Parks and Recreation Commission.
items: Mayoral Appointment: Karen Buck of 323 Forest Street, Malden, as member of the Public Works Commission, term to expire March 1, 2027
Mayoral Appointment: Heather Barry of 10 Hudson Terrace, Malden, as member of the Parks and Recreation Commission, term to expire June 30, 2028
Mayoral Appointment: Ben Gately of 69 Pierce Street, Unit 1, Malden, as member of the Parks and Recreation Commission, term to expire June 30, 2029
Mayoral Appointment: Julie Turner of 265 Forest Street, Malden, as member of the Parks and Recreation Commission, term to expire June 30, 2028
Mayoral Appointment: Jane Ventrone of 33 Dodge Street, Malden, as member of the Parks and Recreation Commission, term to expire June 30, 2029
location: City Hall, Room #105, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA 02148
